flags.why: A khàn consists of three identical cards in tổ tôm or tài bàn, rather than any three cards of the same rank ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kh%C3%A0n)).
flags.fix: set of three identical cards in tổ tôm or tài bàn

flags.why: Calling someone ất ơ dismisses them contemptuously rather than neutrally identifying a random person.
This sense belittles someone's intelligence or behaviour and needs a derogatory warning.
Chẹt does not have the noun meaning 'small corner; nook'; its established senses are verbal and adjectival ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ch%E1%BA%B9t)).
The gloss conflates the religious proper name Hòa Hảo with the dated adjective hòa hảo meaning 'on friendly terms' ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/hoa-hao-eWflCf9aiZhf0.html)).
flags.fix: Separate Hòa Hảo, noun: 'Hoa Hao (a Buddhist movement of the Mekong Delta)', from hòa hảo, adjective [dated]: 'on friendly terms; having amicable relations'.
